text:
Aisha K: Heads up — I'm at the airport and my flight got delayed (~2+ hrs). I'm currently primary for the night window but there's an active page (INC-2026-331). I need someone to pick up primary ASAP; I can shadow but wifi is flaky.

oncall-bot: INC-2026-331 | Severity: P2 | Service: embeddings | Symptom: 95th/99th latency spike, errors rising. Alerts routed to @aisha, @jonas. Active alerts: 8/11 hosts above latency threshold.

Jonas M: I can take primary now. Give me the quick state and any runbook pointers or hotfixes you've applied.

Aisha K: Thanks @jonas. Quick state: restarted model pool gpux-emb-06 once at +00:12; observed p95 drop briefly then crept back. Did a light config tweak on canary (reduced batch size). Customer impact: search embeddings slower, ~0.2% error rate (retries masking some failures). Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/embeddings-latency — key snippets below.

```
# quick checks
curl -s http://metrics.internal/embeddings/health | jq .
# restart pool node
rtxctl restart gpux-emb-06
# revert batch size
kubectl set env deploy/emb-service BATCH_SIZE=32 -n embeddings
# check redis cache
redis-cli -h rds-emb --eval "GET top_keys"
```

Priya S: I'm currently secondary, I can shadow and take alerts if needed. @jonas when you flip primary, pls ack here so we know rotation state and to avoid duplicate actions. I'll also update the incident doc.

Jonas M: Ack — taking primary now. Promoting in rotation. Command I ran: `oncallctl promote --user jonas --role primary --channel eng-oncall` — done. I'm picking up the pager and will drive mitigation.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook "embeddings-latency" invoked by Aisha K. Checklist started: 1) verify health endpoints 2) validate pool restart 3) monitor canary p95 for 10m 4) prepare capacity bump.

Aisha K: FYI I lowered BATCH_SIZE on the canary from 32->16 to reduce tail latency. If it helps, you can scale canary replicas up to 3: `kubectl scale deploy/emb-canary --replicas=3 -n embeddings`.

Jonas M: Noted. I'll scale to 3 next and watch p95/p99. If latency persists after scaling, we'll roll more nodes or route traffic away from gpux-emb-06. @priya if alerts spike above 10 active hosts, please escalate to infra-pools channel.

Priya S: :thumbsup: watching dashboards and alert counts. I'm adding a short note to the incident doc with time, who promoted, and config changes.

Jonas M: Primary confirmed. Leaving this thread as the handover record: - Promoted: @jonas at 1766122338 - Prior primary: @aisha (traveling) - Actions done: restarted gpux-emb-06; lowered canary BATCH_SIZE; scaled canary planned to 3. - Monitoring: p95/p99 and error rate.

Aisha K: Massive thanks everyone. I'll try to join from plane wifi but if not, I'll take back primary once I'm back at a stable connection. If you need contact, ping my mobile.

Jonas M: Safe travels. I'll update here when the incident stabilizes and when I hand back.

Priya S: I'll stay on shadow for next 30m then rotate to normal secondary, unless we get a handback.

Jonas M: Quick checklist for whoever follows: 1) Confirm runbook link is the source of truth 2) Note any ad-hoc config changes in incident doc 3) Revert canary tweaks only after 15m stable window 4) If scaling doesn't help, open infra-pools ticket and request temporary capacity.

Aisha K: adding final note — customer impact updated in incident board: "partial latency degradation for search embeddings; retries mitigate most user-visible errors; working on tail latency reduction."

Jonas M: Thread log saved. Primary/secondary swap complete.
